objective: For the certified limit-only example, prove that all bonds from a top port to an own distinction at depth s grow at least linearly, allowing every side branch, and supply a matching order of growth. Check that every finite observed variable belongs to one ray block or its side descendants, and three consecutive empty blocks forget the input interface.
status: Proved in one branching limit-only family. With arbitrary finite support and targets on the first recursive branch, the least bond size lies between ceil(s/3)+1 and ceil(s/2)+2 for all s >= 1.
title: Unrestricted bond growth in the branching depth-two example
